notes.title: v1.1.12 Update + Price Drop
notes.content:
Blast Rush Classic 1.1.12 is now available.Details:
Fixed an issue with triggering Manual Hyperdodge after it was activated.

Swapped Confirm/Cancel on the keyboard mapping from Z/X to X/Z.

Control remappings are now saved to the system registry (i.e., not to cloud).

Fixed an issue with the How To Play scene's display on ultrawide resolutions.

Minor graphics tweaks.


New Price for Blast Rush Classic
Blast Rush LS is out now, and includes the original Blast Rush in "Classic" mode. Given that, we're dropping Blast Rush Classic's base price to USD $0.99 (and international equivalents) from here on. 

We encourage everyone who has Blast Rush Classic to give Blast Rush LS a try -- you can download the BRLS Demo to sample what's new and improved, and wishlist or purchase if you like what you see!



Thanks for your support,

Your Friends at BDog
(Follow on Bluesky!)

notes.title: Introducing Blast Rush LS!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37461662/46b259b066158cfc94c39d50d0f3900ebe292e20.jpg

An all-new version of Blast Rush is rushing your way in 2025!

Blast Rush LS is more than a port; it's a collection of new and legacy content tailor-made for a PC/console experience. Here's just some of the differences:


 Spruced-up graphics with a retro-accurate resolution
 2 new bombs per ship, for a total of 9 different bomb types
 4 unique minigames that further play with shoot-em-up concepts
 Bonus and archival content like developer notes, WIP art, and a soundtrack player

We'll have more info on Blast Rush LS leading up to release. In the meantime... 

Wishlist Now!

notes.title: v1.1.10 Update
notes.content:
A new version of Blast Rush is now available. Here are the details on this update:


Fixed bug where Crystal Heron didn't have its stronger bullets
Fixed bug with "Skip" button in "How to Play" 
Minor fix in Standard mode graphics
Removal of analytics

notes.title: Where to Get a High-Quality Soundtrack
notes.content:
Blast Rush Classic includes the Blast Rush Original Soundtrack for free, but you can also get higher quality versions (FLAC, etc.) for purchase. If you like what you hear, we strongly recommend supporting the artist directly. (In other words, Bipedal Dog receives no proceeds from soundtrack sales.) Just follow this link:

Blast Rush Original Soundtrack | Bandcamp

Thanks and have fun!
